decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is far from the firm's core building lighting knowledge, which limits its ability to interpret results and improve the line, but the firm's maritime customer base and in-house testing give it enough related knowledge to sustain this niche defence line for now.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build directly on the firm's certified manufacturing and LED know-how, and the 2019 retrofit kit shows the firm is actively absorbing feedback and extending the line.
The relaunched designer task light sits close to the firm's established offer, so the firm can easily interpret its market results and update it with LED advances at low cost.
The pendant office luminaire draws on core office-lighting knowledge, and the firm's R&D lets it refine the product efficiently within its existing portfolio.
This multi-model premium pendant line leverages existing design and LED engineering expertise, fitting the firm's direction toward energy-efficient, long-life solutions.
